preview.text: Denmark won the toss and chose to bat first in their one-day match against Kuwait at Gymkhana Club Ground. The usual first-innings score in the 24 recorded one-day matches at Gymkhana Club Ground is 216. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 59 per cent chance of rain and about 28 degrees.

summary.text: Denmark won by 102 runs. DEN made 274-8, Musa Shaheen Mahmood top-scoring with 64 off 84 balls; Meet Bhavsar took 3 for 52. KUW made 172-10, Clinto Anto top-scoring with 52 off 27 balls; Saif Ahmad took 5 for 20. Sides batting first at Gymkhana Club Ground usually make about 216.
